data.name: The Mirror Circle
data.detailed_description:
SYNOPSIS

Naomi embarks on a desperate journey to an old mountain hotel that has been abandoned for decades, after receiving a disturbing message from her missing sister. What was once a peaceful tourist refuge is now a dark labyrinth, frozen in time… and filled with lingering presences that refuse to be forgotten.

Armed only with a ritual mirror—a family heirloom—Naomi must confront entities that can only be seen, weakened, and ultimately purified through their reflection. Every step she takes inside the hotel brings her closer to the truth… but also closer to the same fate that trapped its previous victims forever.

MAIN FEATURES

A Unique Weapon: The Ritual Mirror

This is not a conventional weapon.
The mirror allows Naomi to reveal invisible spirits, weaken them through their reflection, and finally purify them before they consume her.
The longer you stare at them in the mirror… the longer they stare back.

An Abandoned Hotel Full of Memories and Danger

Explore more than 20 interconnected rooms filled with narrow hallways, collapsed areas, and forbidden zones.
Every room hides a piece of Naomi’s sister’s story… and a new horror waiting within the shadows.

Psychological Horror and Oppressive Atmosphere

Sounds distort, lights flicker, and the hotel’s own reality becomes twisted as Naomi descends deeper into its lower floors.
This is not an action game—tension is constant.

Immersive Camera System

Switch between first-person view for precise exploration or third-person view for better spatial awareness.
Each perspective brings its own flavor of terror.

A Deep Story About the Bond Between Sisters

Collect notes, photographs, and memories that reveal what truly happened inside the hotel… and why Naomi’s sister became trapped there.

Entities That Learn

The spirits react to your footsteps, your light… even your breathing.
Some flee from the mirror.
Others crave it.

data.short_description: Naomi enters an abandoned mountain hotel searching for her missing sister. Armed only with a ritual mirror that reveals and purifies spirits, she must confront invisible horrors and uncover the truth hidden within the darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / GTX 1060 3GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 16 bit stereo, 48kHz WAVE file can be played
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on mid-range hardware. Performance may vary depending on resolution and post-processing effects.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / RTX 3060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 16 bit stereo, 48kHz WAVE file can be played
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for stable 60 FPS with higher visual settings.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains horror themes and elements that may be disturbing to some players. These include:

Ghostly apparitions, hostile entities, and unsettling supernatural imagery.

Scenes of psychological tension such as eerie sounds, dark environments, hallucinations, and environmental distortions.

Mild to moderate violence, mainly during encounters with spirits (no explicit gore).

Themes related to death, disappearances, and past tragedies connected to the hotel.

An oppressive atmosphere that may cause anxiety or distress.

The game does NOT include:

Explicit sexual content.

Nudity.

Extreme graphic violence or explicit gore.

Sexual abuse, non-consensual content, or exploitation.
